resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two register entries share the name Buffalo Lookout Tower: US 1764 (Searcy County, privately owned; this record) and US 672 (Newton County, Forest Service; research id us-ar-buffalo-2). They are treated as different towers.

notes_for_editor: Single register entry with no history beyond the 2022 site visit. Name collision: US 1764 is not the Newton County Forest Service tower (US 672, us-ar-buffalo-2). Wikipedia's Boston Mountains article places Wahzhazhe Summit, formerly known as Buffalo Lookout, at 35.8637, -93.4931, which matches US 672, not this record; it is not cited here. Consider whether the US 1764 title needs a qualifier so the two do not get merged. Brief's 'standing' is not supported by the register, so it is proposed as unknown.
